zh-CN.title: KurrentDB
zh-CN.description: 将运行事件以事件溯源方式存储到 KurrentDB。

usage.title: 选择运行事件后端
usage.description: 在 config.yaml 中设置 run_events.backend: kurrent，运行事件将写入 KurrentDB 流。

requirements: 管理员已部署 KurrentDB 并设置 KURRENTDB_CONNECTION_STRING 环境变量。

en-US.title: KurrentDB
en-US.description: Store run events in KurrentDB as event-sourced streams.

usage.title: Select the run-event backend
usage.description: Set run_events.backend: kurrent in config.yaml so run events are written to KurrentDB streams.

requirements: The administrator must run KurrentDB and set the KURRENTDB_CONNECTION_STRING environment variable.
